lead.title: Softway Medical puts numbers on the breach of its One Manager radiology software: 11 million patients exposed, 4 million of them with their social security number
lead.deck: The vendor told TICsanté the toll of the cyberattack that hit One Manager, its radiology information system, in early November: administrative data on some 11 million patients leaked, and for about 4 million of them the social security number was on file. A vendor incident rather than a hospital one, it knocks on to the imaging centres that use the software and turns software supply-chain security (vendor access, segmentation, logging) into a purchasing and due-diligence criterion in its own right across health software.

milestone.title: The TOP-REAL trial tests app, pulse-oximeter and smartwatch remote monitoring to catch trastuzumab deruxtecan toxicities earlier in HER2+ breast cancer
milestone.summary: Run by Spanish academic group SOLTI with Unicancer and the West German Study Group, and supported by AstraZeneca and Daiichi Sankyo, the phase II trial targets around 300 patients at 60 centres in Spain, France and Germany receiving first-line T-DXd plus pertuzumab. Between visits, patients report ePROs in the CANKADO or Resilience app depending on the country, check their oxygen saturation daily and wear a smartwatch, to spot interstitial lung disease early; enrolment is under way in Spain and France and recruitment is open in Germany.
milestone.why: Here digital remote monitoring is not a bolt-on module but the tool meant to keep patients on one of the most effective drugs in HER2+ breast cancer: a concrete oncology use case, backed by cooperative groups and industry, for two European remote-follow-up apps. Presented at ESMO AI & Digital Oncology 2026 (press release dated November 20).

brefsEurope.company: Office fédéral de la santé publique (OFSP)
brefsEurope.title: Switzerland sketches a federated health data space, SwissHDS, built on HL7 FHIR and with no central national database
brefsEurope.summary: Presented on November 23 in Bern at the annual meeting of the DigiSanté programme, the model leaves data with the institutions and professionals that produce it, with shared services handling exchange; the national health data governance group recommends FHIR as the foundation, a central patient registry will link identities across hospitals and practices, and SwissHDS will share its technical infrastructure with the future electronic patient record. The legal bases are being drafted, with a public consultation planned for summer 2027: a window for interoperability vendors.

brefsEurope.title: DigitalRadar scores German hospitals' digital maturity at 55 out of 100, up from 33.3 in 2021, but telehealth still trails
brefsEurope.summary: Commissioned by the Federal Ministry of Health, the consortium credits the roughly 65% rise to the KHZG hospital fund: €1,000 of funding per bed is associated on average with a 1.2-point gain, and the improvement spans every hospital size and every federal state. The two weakest dimensions remain patient participation (29.5% fulfilment) and telehealth (28.7%): ground still to be equipped by patient-portal and remote-monitoring vendors.

brefsEurope.title: Cyberattack at CHU de Guadeloupe: emergency plan triggered, operations and scans postponed until November 27
brefsEurope.summary: Hit on Saturday November 21, the hospital found its databases encrypted; business applications and internal telephony are heavily disrupted across its three sites, and the new Belle-Plaine hospital in Les Abymes is affected to a lesser degree. Management, which cites a possible but unconfirmed compromise at an IT contractor, is working with ANSSI; the emergency department and SAMU are running, and wards have gone back to paper.

brefsEurope.title: France's ANS opens its 2027 digital health doctrine to consultation until January 15, financial penalties included
brefsEurope.summary: Opened on November 23 to hospitals, professionals and software vendors, the consultation covers access conditions for the DMP shared medical record, digital identification of professionals, how care-coordination tools (e-Parcours) fit with practice software, and regulation, including financial penalties for failing certain requirements. The update also folds in the Cyber Resilience Act and HDS certification requirements; a presentation webinar is set for November 26 with DGRINES, the national health insurer and GIE SESAM-Vitale.

brefsEurope.title: ELSAN brings onto its supervisory board Mehdi Ghissassi, a former applied-AI leader at Google Brain and DeepMind
brefsEurope.summary: At Google from 2012 to 2024, now head of product and technology at Abu Dhabi's AI71 and chair of Teleperformance's AI & Innovation committee, he is to support the clinic group's ambition to become, by 2030, a European benchmark for deploying AI at scale in hospitals. First uses cited: fracture-detection support and analysis of patient feedback, an implicit call for clinical and administrative AI startups.

brefsEurope.title: Equasens launches Eqwo, an online booking tool with teleconsultation built into its MediStory practice software
brefsEurope.summary: Unveiled on November 19, the app combines appointment booking, teleconsultation and document exchange for under €100 a month incl. VAT per self-employed doctor; it starts on MediStory and its 15,000+ users, before easy-care and then pharmacy software in H1 2027. Already used by pilot practices, it rolls out in Q1 2027: a practice-software vendor going head-on at the booking platforms' turf.

brefsEurope.title: Digizorg, Erasmus MC's data-exchange platform, expands into elderly and home care after pioneers Aafje and Laurens
brefsEurope.summary: Since this year the two Rotterdam care organisations use the Digizorg Cockpit to view lab results, appointments and letters from connected hospitals, with about 90 users; Amarijn's Zeeland sites and the Zorgring network in Noord-Holland Noord are preparing to follow, PharmaPartners is opening the link to GP practices on Medicom, and a first version of a patient app is expected by year-end; the platform is expanding with IZA agreement funding.

brefsEurope.title: Amsterdam UMC, UvA and VU launch Amsterdam MedTech to get innovations, AI and digital care included, to the bedside faster
brefsEurope.summary: The new ecosystem starts from concrete care problems to connect clinicians, researchers, technologists and companies around imaging, photonics, AI, digital care and robotics, applied to oncology, cardiovascular care, neurology and mental health. First project: exploring lung cancer diagnosis and treatment in a single procedure, combining HHG microscopy and AI; it ties into the Dutch goal of having Europe's strongest MedTech sector by 2035.

word.full: Hébergeur de Données de Santé (French health data hosting certification)
word.definition: A mandatory French certification for any organisation that hosts or operates personal health data on behalf of a third party: without it, a health software product cannot store its customers' records.

parts.label: COFRAC-accredited body
parts.role: the auditor that issues the certificate

parts.label: Six activities
parts.role: the scope, from data centre to backup

how.t: The host picks which of six activities it certifies: physical sites, hardware infrastructure, virtual infrastructure, application hosting platform, system administration and operation, outsourced backup.
A COFRAC-accredited certification body audits it against the framework drawn up by the ANS; data must stay within the European Economic Area, and encryption does not exempt anyone from certification.
The certificate lasts three years and carries ongoing duties, such as keeping for each customer an up-to-date health-professional contact that can be handed to the authorities without delay.

word.why: For a digital health startup, HDS is the entry ticket to the French market: most lean on a certified host rather than certifying themselves, which makes the choice of host and the exact scope of the certificate a key due-diligence point. With the Softway Medical breach and the ANS 2027 doctrine folding in HDS requirements, hosting security and sovereignty are becoming a sales argument as much as a compliance box.
